name: How long does it take to settle an Uber passenger injury claim?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to settle an Uber passenger injury claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an Uber passenger injury claim varies greatly depending on several factors, including the complexity of the accident, the severity of your injuries, the time it takes for you to reach maximum medical improvement, and the responsiveness of insurance companies. Straightforward cases with minor injuries might resolve in a few months, while more complex cases involving serious injuries or extensive negotiations could take a year or more. If a lawsuit becomes necessary, the process can extend even longer. An attorney can provide a more accurate estimate after reviewing the specifics of your case.
acceptedAnswer.description: Settlement times for Uber passenger injury claims vary from months to over a year, depending on accident complexity, injury severity, and insurance company responsiveness. Lawsuits can further extend the process.
